* Swiss Roll, San Juan NF, USFS. Eleven miles east of Pagosa Springs, CO. Timber. Extreme fire behavior 
with crowning, short crown runs and wind-driven runs. Energy infrastructure threatened. Area and road 
closures in effect. 
 
Moonshine, High Desert District, BLM. Seventeen miles southwest of Wheatland, WY. Timber and brush. 
Active fire behavior with backing, torching and short-range spotting. Residences threatened. Evacuations in 
effect. 
 
Lookout, South Dakota Division of Wildland Fire. One mile north of Spearfish, SD. Timber and grass. Minimal 
fire behavior with smoldering. 
 
Aspen Acres, Custer County. Twenty miles southwest of Pueblo, CO. Timber. Minimal fire behavior. 
 
Willow, Pike and San Isabel NF, USFS. Six miles west of Leadville, CO. Brush, closed timber litter and timber. 
Minimal fire behavior. Reduction in acreage due to more accurate mapping. 
 
Elk, Grand Mesa, Uncompahgre and Gunnison NF, USFS. Seven miles northwest of Lake City, CO. Grass 
and timber. No new information. Last narrative report unless new information is received.
